name: Staghelm's Requiem
label: Quest
description: Staghelm's Requiem: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Staghelm has given the order. All trolls on the field of battle must be exterminated. Their preposterous claims of birthing night elves must be met with force and due prejudice.
Slay them and return to me with their mojo. To reiterate: I want you to steal their mojo.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can still smell the stinking trolls.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. The air is a little more pure.
